transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling card member services. How can I assist you today?
Customer: Hi, yeah, I'm looking over my bill and I found something strange on it that shouldn't be there.
Agent: I can certainly help look into that. May I have your full name and the billing zip code on your account?
Customer: Sure, it's Corinne Abara, and the zip code is 97201.
Agent: Thank you, Ms. Abara. Which statement are you reviewing, and what seems to be the issue?
Customer: It's on my September 30, 2026 statement. There's a little fee here for something I definitely didn't buy.
Agent: Could you tell me the date of that transaction and the name of the company listed?
Customer: It shows up on September 20, 2026, and the name is StreamNest Plus.
Agent: And how much was that transaction for?
Customer: It was for $4.99.
Agent: Have you ever had an account or subscription with StreamNest Plus in the past?
Customer: No, never. I don't even know what that is. It sounds like some video service, but I never signed up for anything like that.
Agent: Has anyone else had access to your card, or could a family member have used it?
Customer: No, I live alone and my card never leaves my purse.
Agent: Have you reached out to StreamNest Plus directly about this fee?
Customer: No, I haven't contacted them. I just saw it and called you guys directly as soon as I opened the mail.
Agent: All right. So to make sure I have all the details noted, you see a $4.99 charge from StreamNest Plus from September 20, 2026, on your September 30, 2026 statement, for a service you never set up and have never used.
Customer: Yes, that is exactly it.
